title: The Messengership Of Prophet Muhammad 16th Degree 7th Proof The Affirmation Of The Family And Companions

questions.question: Who carefully checked the Prophet’s actions, thoughts, and ways in this passage?
questions.answer: His family and his companions.

questions.question: What good qualities are said about the family and companions?
questions.answer: They had deep understanding, knowledge, strong faith, respect, and careful sight.

questions.question: Did they look only at what people could see, or also at what was hidden?
questions.answer: They looked at both what was open and what was hidden.

questions.question: How carefully did they study him?
questions.answer: Very carefully and seriously.

questions.question: What did they all agree about him?
questions.answer: They agreed that he was the most truthful, noble, and honest person.

questions.question: Was this decision made by just one person or by all of them together?
questions.answer: By all of them together.

questions.question: What does their strong agreement become in the passage?
questions.answer: It becomes a clear proof.

questions.question: What picture is used to show how clear this proof is?
questions.answer: The clearness of daylight and the reality of the sun.

questions.question: What is the main idea of the whole passage?
questions.answer: The Prophet’s family and companions carefully examined him and strongly confirmed his truthfulness.

questions.question: Which two groups are named at the start of the passage?
questions.answer: The Prophet’s family and his companions.

questions.question: After the prophets, how are these people described?
questions.answer: They are described as among the most respected, pious, and sharp-sighted people.

questions.question: What kinds of things did they study about him?
questions.answer: They studied his condition, thoughts, and actions.

questions.question: Did they do this in a light way or in a very exact way?
questions.answer: In a very exact way.

questions.question: What was their final judgment about him?
questions.answer: They believed he was completely truthful, honorable, and honest.

questions.question: What word shows that they all shared the same judgment?
questions.answer: They were united in it.

questions.question: How strong was their belief after studying him?
questions.answer: It was firm and could not be shaken.

questions.question: What comparison helps us understand the strength of their proof?
questions.answer: It is compared to bright daylight showing the sun is real.

questions.question: What does the passage say about the understanding of the Prophet’s family and companions?
questions.answer: It says they had strong insight and knowledge.

questions.question: What did they do before making a decision about him?
questions.answer: They examined him closely.

questions.question: Did they pay attention to small details, or did they ignore them?
questions.answer: They paid close attention to details.

questions.question: What parts of his life did they examine?
questions.answer: They examined private and public parts of his life.

questions.question: What did they conclude from all this checking?
questions.answer: They concluded that he was true and trustworthy.

questions.question: Name one quality they agreed he had.
questions.answer: Honesty.

questions.question: What does the example of daylight teach us about their witness?
questions.answer: It teaches that their witness is very clear and strong.

questions.question: Say the passage in one short sentence.
questions.answer: Careful and godly people around the Prophet saw his truth clearly and agreed about it.

questions.question: Who are the people giving testimony in this passage?
questions.answer: The Prophet’s family and companions.

questions.question: What makes these people special according to the passage?
questions.answer: They are known for wisdom, learning, faith, and clear understanding.

questions.question: How did they deal with the question of who he was?
questions.answer: They investigated it with care and seriousness.

questions.question: Did they examine only his words, or more than that?
questions.answer: More than that; they examined his states, thoughts, and conditions.

questions.question: What does looking at hidden and open things show about their method?
questions.answer: It shows they were thorough.

questions.question: What three big qualities did they agree he had?
questions.answer: Truthfulness, nobility, and honesty.

questions.question: What kind of agreement did they reach?
questions.answer: A complete shared agreement.

questions.question: Why is the image of the sun and daylight a good comparison here?
questions.answer: Because both are easy to see clearly, just like their proof.

questions.question: What lesson should a student take from this passage?
questions.answer: Careful, truthful people recognized the Prophet’s honesty and were united about it.

questions.question: In the passage, who spent time checking the Prophet very carefully?
questions.answer: His family and companions did.

questions.question: Were these ordinary people with little understanding, or people with strong understanding?
questions.answer: They were people with strong understanding.

questions.question: What are some ways the passage praises them?
questions.answer: It says they were well-known, honored, devoted, and sharp in seeing truth.

questions.question: What did they examine about him?
questions.answer: They examined everything about him, inside and outside.

questions.question: After their careful study, what did they decide?
questions.answer: They decided he was the truest and most honest person.

questions.question: Did the passage show doubt among them, or full agreement?
questions.answer: It showed full agreement.

questions.question: How sure were they about what they decided?
questions.answer: They were very sure and steady in that belief.

questions.question: What does their agreement prove in the passage?
questions.answer: It proves his truth in a very clear way.

questions.question: What is the best main idea for this passage?
questions.answer: The people closest to the Prophet carefully tested him and clearly confirmed his truthfulness.

questions.question: Which people are spoken about in this passage as close to the Prophet?
questions.answer: His family and companions.

questions.question: How are they ranked compared with other people after the prophets?
questions.answer: They are shown as among the finest people after the prophets.

questions.question: What good abilities did they have?
questions.answer: They had insight, knowledge, and spiritual strength.

questions.question: What was their attitude when they examined him?
questions.answer: They were careful, serious, and exact.

questions.question: What areas of his life did they not leave out?
questions.answer: They left out nothing, whether hidden or seen.

questions.question: What conclusion did they all come to?
questions.answer: That he was the most truthful, honored, and honest person.

questions.question: Why does their conclusion carry weight?
questions.answer: Because they were qualified and they examined him closely.

questions.question: What does the passage say their belief is like?
questions.answer: It is like bright daylight proving the sun is real.

questions.question: If you had to tell this passage to a friend in one line, what would you say?
questions.answer: The Prophet’s family and companions knew him well, checked him carefully, and all agreed he was truly honest and noble.
